Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::modifyBankCard(cardid:Integer,cardstatus:CardStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND|CANCEL],catalog:CardCatalog[CREDIT|DEPOSIT],password:Integer,balance:Real): Boolean {
          definition:
          cardBank:Set(BankCard) = BankCard.allInstance()->select(o | o.CardID = cardid), cardExists:Boolean = cardBank->size() > 0, result:Boolean
            
            precondition:
          BankCard.allInstance()->exists(o | o.CardID = cardid)
            
            postcondition:
          cardExists implies (cardBank->forAll(o | o.CardID = cardid and o.CardStatus = cardstatus and o.Catalog = catalog and o.Password = password and o.Balance = balance)) and result = cardExists
            
        }
